_comment: Chain-of-custody sidecar written by _commit_step_with_custody() (src/geoff_pipeline.py:457) immediately when a step completes. SHA-256 of the evidence file and SHA-256 of the step parameters are recorded so any modification to the evidence after the step ran produces a detectable hash mismatch. This is detective (not preventive) — it proves tampering but does not prevent it.
